response.sql:
WITH constructor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    c.constructorId,
    c.nationality,
    COUNT(cs.constructorStandingsId) AS record_count
  FROM constructors AS c
  LEFT JOIN constructorStandings AS cs
    ON cs.constructorId = c.constructorId
  GROUP BY c.constructorId, c.nationality
),
average_count AS (
  SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count
  FROM constructor_counts
)
SELECT
  cc.constructorId,
  cc.nationality,
  cc.record_count,
  cc.record_count - ac.avg_count AS difference_from_average
FROM constructor_counts AS cc
CROSS JOIN average_count AS ac
ORDER BY difference_from_average DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The average is across all rows in constructors, including constructors with zero standings records, as specified.
